research_scope: Early/base-game Parallel Quest skills selected after checking the canonical seeded index for previously indexed identities.

verification_audit.method: Checked candidate names against the current canonical skills response and repository search, then reconciled identity, classification, acquisition, and core mechanics against independent Xenoverse 2 references. Evil Flight Strike was excluded because it was already present in the canonical index. Exact reward probabilities were not inferred when the consulted sources did not establish them.

records.name: Mach Punch
records.character_source: Burter; Captain Ginyu (Customize Partner); Jiren (Customize Partner)
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 19 — Fierce Battle! Ginyu Force; later available through applicable Partner Customization
records.source_quest_or_shop: Parallel Quest 19 — Fierce Battle! Ginyu Force
records.skill_description: A fast short-range flurry of punches that ends with a kick that knocks the opponent away; a successful hit can transition directly into an Ultimate Attack.
records.mechanics_notes: Reference data identifies a 100-Ki Strike Super with six punches followed by a knock-away kick, totaling seven hit events in the documented sequence. The move can be Ultimate Attack cancelled on hit. Exact current damage is not treated as universal.
records.combo_notes: Its short range is offset by fast activation and the ability to convert a confirmed hit directly into an Ultimate.
records.pve_notes: The quick rush and Ultimate-cancel property make it useful as a compact combo finisher against AI.
records.pvp_notes: The move has limited reach, so spacing and confirms are important; the Ultimate-cancel property rewards clean connections.

records.name: Fighting Pose E
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 19 — Fierce Battle! Ginyu Force
records.source_quest_or_shop: Parallel Quest 19 — Fierce Battle! Ginyu Force
records.skill_description: Strike a pose to temporarily increase the user's normal/basic attack.
records.mechanics_notes: Reference data identifies Fighting Pose E as a Power Up Super with no Ki cost and a documented 20-second duration. The documented effect is a temporary basic-attack increase; the exact magnitude is not asserted here without a stronger current numeric source.
records.combo_notes: This is a preparation/buff skill rather than a direct attack and therefore should be documented separately from damage-combo mechanics.
records.pve_notes: Its zero-Ki activation and temporary Basic Attack boost make it relevant to sustained basic-attack builds.
records.pvp_notes: The activation window creates an opportunity cost because the user is not directly attacking while posing; exact defensive properties should not be inferred.

records.name: Mystic Flash
records.skill_description: Turns the user around and fires a powerful Ki wave behind them; it cannot be fired forward.
records.mechanics_notes: Reference data identifies Mystic Flash as a 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate with a rear-only wave, approximately 25 hit events, and documented knockback. The unusual rear-only firing direction is the defining mechanical property.
records.combo_notes: Its rear-only orientation requires deliberate positioning or a setup that places the target behind the user before activation.
records.pve_notes: The large rear-facing wave can catch AI opponents positioned behind the player, but its directional restriction makes blind use unreliable.
records.pvp_notes: The attack's unusual orientation can create mix-up potential, but it is highly position-dependent and cannot be treated as a conventional forward Ultimate.

records.name: Energy Shot
records.character_source: Goku; Gohan (Kid); Gohan (Adult); Gohan (Future); Piccolo; Krillin; Tien; Yamcha; Raditz; Nappa; Vegeta; Zarbon; Dodoria; Guldo; Captain Ginyu; Appule; Lord Slug; Frieza (1st Form); Cooler (Final Form); Videl; Great Saiyaman 2; Majin Buu; Cell (Perfect); Android 18; Gotenks; Turles; Pan; Bardock; God of Destruction Beerus; Bojack; Zamasu; Fu; others via Customize Partner systems
records.skill_description: Fires a chargeable Ki Blast; charging increases the projectile's damage.
records.mechanics_notes: Reference data identifies a 100-Ki chargeable Ki Blast Super with a single-hit knockback projectile. The cited reference reports approximately 3% base damage and 15% at maximum charge; these are retained as reference measurements rather than immutable universal values.
records.combo_notes: The charge mechanic trades startup time for stronger projectile damage, making the uncharged and charged versions useful in different spacing situations.
records.pve_notes: The simple charge-and-projectile structure makes it broadly usable as a basic ranged option, especially early in progression.
records.pvp_notes: Charging exposes the user to interruption, while uncharged shots provide faster but weaker pressure; exact frame timing remains version-sensitive.

records.name: Ginyu Force Special Combo
records.skill_description: A multi-option rush attack whose follow-up pattern changes according to directional input.
records.mechanics_notes: Reference data identifies a 100-Ki Strike Super with multiple directional routes. Neutral and directional inputs produce different hit sequences; one documented route includes a guard-breaking forward kick. The move is notable for having several selectable attack patterns rather than one fixed string.
records.combo_notes: Directional input determines the route, allowing the user to choose different endings including knock-away, knockdown, or guard-breaking behavior.
records.pve_notes: The selectable routes make the skill adaptable to different AI positions and combo states.
records.pvp_notes: Directional variability is the primary mix-up property. The exact optimal route depends on the opponent's position and defensive state rather than one universal sequence.
